criteria.given: ff_people_module is enabled and user is onboarded
criteria.when: user opens navigation HR & Payroll section
criteria.then: a People tab is visible and selecting it renders the People module

criteria.when: user adds an employee with valid name, email, CTC, doj
criteria.then: employee appears in the list with status Onboarding or Active as chosen

criteria.when: user opens their profile from People
criteria.then: identity, CTC, documents flags, status, and salary revisions section are shown
transition is rejected with an explanatory message
status becomes Notice and employee remains payroll-eligible

criteria.when: user sets employee E on date D to Present
criteria.then: record is persisted and reopening the month shows Present for E on D

criteria.given: employee has at least one payroll slip in history
criteria.then: delete is rejected and message instructs Exit then Archive

criteria.when: user adds revision to 1400000 with reason Annual
criteria.then: employee.ctc becomes 1400000 and salaryRevisions contains the prior value
People tab is hidden and Payroll remains available
